units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23">Gen. R. s. 23</cite> <he>פָּכְרָה רוח … ופְכָרוֹ</he> (or <he>פִּכְּרָה</he>, <he>ופִכְּרוֹ</he>) the wind split (knocked down) one tree, and it fell on its neighbor and knocked it down; (Yalk. ib. 39 <he>פֵּרְכָה … ופֵירְכוֹ</he>).—Part. pass. <he>פָּכוּר</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00924">next w.</cite>
